newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's La Moderna sees '97 sales up.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's La Moderna sees '97 sales up.

text.p: Mexican conglomerate Empresas La Moderna expects 1997 sales to rise to $1.6 billion from the $1.4 billion recorded last year, the company's chief financial officer Enrique Osorio Lopez told reporters on Wednesday.
"We expect to reach $1.6 billion in 1997, 45 percent of which will be in foreign currency," he said.
He added that the company plans investments of $75 million this year to replace machinery and equipment.
The CFO said the company expected cigarette exports to jump to $55 million in 1997 from the $49 million in 1996.
He added company directors were currently in Russia looking into the possibility that La Moderna's Montana brand be produced there and sold in that part of the world.
